subject: Media Literacy
title: The Future of Truth
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Future of Truth.

hook.text: AI can generate a perfect fake news article in five seconds. A journalist takes five days to investigate the truth.

buildup.text: AI is making misinformation creation faster, cheaper, and more convincing than ever before.

discovery.text: New tools like AI-generated text, synthetic voices, and fake images are outpacing detection technology.

twist.text: The solution isn't just better technology. It's a society that values truth enough to invest in verification.

climax.text: The future of truth depends on whether we build systems that reward accuracy over engagement.

punchline.text: Truth is expensive. Lies are free. Choose which one to invest in.

quiz.question: What is the fundamental challenge for the future of truth?
options: Building systems that reward accuracy over engagement in a world where lies are cheap
People will naturally become better at fact-checking
